title: Ava — Founder Editorial Shoot
grade: Grade: warm golden Kodak Portra 400 look, soft natural skin tones, gentle halation, creamy film grain, sun-kissed highlights.
craft: Craft: shot on Hasselblad X2D medium format, 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, three-point studio lighting (softbox key, rim, fill), rich dynamic range, crisp detail, premium photographic finish, no warping, no artifacts.
subject: Subject: Ava, a 29-year-old startup founder, slim athletic build with a defined jawline, warm hazel eyes and a subtle confident expression, long chestnut-brown wavy hair, wearing a tailored cream blazer over a black silk top and straight-leg trousers, gold hoop earrings. Distinctive detail: a small freckle above her left eyebrow.

shots.pose: Walking toward the camera, chin slightly raised, direct confident gaze
shots.setting: Rooftop at dusk, warm string lights softly blurred in the background
shots.lighting: Golden-hour side light with soft shadows
shots.edit: replace the rooftop background with a minimalist grey studio backdrop

shots.pose: Three-quarter view, looking slightly past camera, subtle smile
shots.setting: Plain textured plaster wall, warm neutral tones
shots.lighting: Butterfly lighting, soft even beauty light
shots.edit: swap the warm plaster wall for a cool sage-green backdrop

shots.pose: Full body, standing with weight on one hip, one hand in trouser pocket
shots.setting: Sun-drenched city sidewalk, soft morning light, gentle bokeh
shots.lighting: Diffused window-light quality, natural soft shadows
shots.edit: change her trousers to tailored navy trousers, keep the blazer

shots.pose: Seated at a café table, laughing mid-conversation, holding a coffee cup
shots.setting: Warm café interior, wooden tables, morning sun through the window
shots.lighting: Soft directional window light from the left
shots.edit: add a second coffee cup on the table

shots.pose: Standing at a floor-to-ceiling window, looking out at the city, arms crossed
shots.setting: Modern high-rise office with city skyline at dusk through the glass
shots.lighting: Cool city light mixed with warm interior fill
shots.edit: change the city skyline to a mountain view at golden hour
